integrity: Exact exhaustive classification with two independent finite enumeration methods; all orbit representatives embedded and checked. No independent scientific audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact for six labeled symbols equipped with three fixed complement pairs and words of length two; empty code counted by convention; no larger-alphabet or longer-word conclusion. Historical priority for unindexed enumerations remains provisional.
title: Exact size and symmetry spectra of six-symbol strand-closed circular dinucleotide codes
